_meta.indication: PLUVICTO is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with PSMA-positive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) who have been treated with androgen receptor (AR) pathway inhibition and taxane-based chemotherapy.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized (2:1), multicenter, open-label trial of Lu-177-PSMA-617 plus best standard of care (BSoC) versus BSoC alone.
pivotal_trials.population: Men with progressive, PSMA-positive mCRPC who received at least one AR pathway inhibitor and 1 or 2 prior taxane-based chemotherapy regimens; PSMA-positivity defined by gallium Ga 68 gozetotide uptake greater than normal liver.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Alternative (dual) primary endpoints of overall survival (OS) and radiographic progression-free survival (rPFS) by BICR per PCWG3 criteria; either could be positive to satisfy the primary endpoint.
pivotal_trials.n: N = 831 (Lu-177-PSMA-617 plus BSoC N = 551; BSoC alone N = 280)
pivotal_trials.result: OS met: median 15.3 vs 11.3 months, HR 0.62 (95% CI 0.52, 0.74; p<0.001). rPFS met: median 8.7 vs 3.4 months, HR 0.40 (95% CI 0.31, 0.52; p<0.001).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>=20%): fatigue (43%), dry mouth (39%), nausea (35%), anemia (32%), decreased appetite (21%), and constipation (20%). Serious adverse reactions occurred in 36% of patients. Fatal adverse reactions occurred in 2.8%. Key warnings include myelosuppression and renal toxicity.
target_moa: A beta-emitting small molecule radioligand that binds PSMA (Ki ~4.7 nM) on prostate cancer cells, delivering targeted Lutetium-177 radiation to PSMA-expressing tumor cells.
companion_dx_detail: Patients are selected for treatment using LOCAMETZ or another approved PSMA-11 imaging agent based on PSMA expression in tumors.

advisory_committee.vote: An advisory committee meeting was not convened for this application.

description.text: Expanded indication to PSMA-positive mCRPC patients treated with ARPI therapy considered appropriate to delay taxane-based chemotherapy (pre-taxane setting)

citations.quote: - S-021: Revising the indication to treatment of adult patients with prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-positive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) who have been treated with androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) therapy, and are considered appropriate to delay taxane-based chemotherapy, or have received prior taxane-based chemotherapy, based on the results of study CAAA617B12302 (PSMAfore).

basis.text: The NDA was reviewed under Priority Review (PDUFA goal date March 29, 2022).

summary.text: PLUVICTO's NDA 215833 received a Priority Review and was granted regular (not accelerated) approval based on a statistically significant and clinically meaningful overall survival benefit in the Phase III VISION trial. No advisory committee was convened.

citations.quote: The review team recommends that ^{177}\text{Lu}-PSMA-617 be granted regular approval for the treatment of adult patients with prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-positive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) who have been treated with androgen receptor (AR) pathway inhibition and taxane-based chemotherapy.
An advisory committee meeting was not convened for this application.

requirement.text: PMR 4241-1: Conduct an integrated safety analysis to further characterize long-term outcomes of myelosuppression, renal failure, xerostomia/xerophthalmia, potential secondary malignancies (MDS/AML), and other serious adverse reactions in patients receiving lutetium (177Lu) vipivotide tetraxetan in VISION and other trials.

citations.quote: 4241-1 Conduct an integrated safety analysis to further characterize the long term outcome of the known serious risk of myelosuppression, renal failure, xerostomia and xerophthalmia and their complications; the potential serious signals of secondary malignancies including myelodysplastic syndrome and acute myeloid leukemia (MDS/AML); and other serious adverse reactions in patients receiving lutetium (^{177}\text{Lu}) vipivotide tetraxetan in the VISION study and its sub-study, Trial CAAA617C12301 (NCT04720157), Trial CAAA617B12302 (NCT04689828) and other clinical trials as appropriate.

requirement.text: PMR 4241-2: Conduct a clinical trial to determine kidney biodistribution, dosimetry, pharmacokinetics, and safety of lutetium (177Lu) vipivotide tetraxetan and assess the potential for higher drug exposure and increased serious toxicities in patients with moderate and severe renal impairment.

citations.quote: 4241-2 Conduct a clinical trial to determine the kidney biodistribution, dosimetry, pharmacokinetics, and safety of lutetium (^{177}\text{Lu}) vipivotide tetraxetan and assess the potential for higher drug exposure and the resultant risk of increased serious toxicities in patients with moderate and severe renal impairment.

requirement.text: PMC 4241-3: Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate efficacy and safety of lutetium (177Lu) vipivotide tetraxetan in patients with advanced/metastatic prostate cancer who have at least one lesion with high PSMA expression and at least one lesion with PSMA expression less than or equal to normal liver uptake exceeding size criteria.

citations.quote: 4241-3 Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of lutetium (^{177}\text{Lu}) vipivotide tetraxetan in patients with advanced/metastatic prostate cancer who have at least one lesion with PSMA expression higher than that in normal liver parenchyma on PSMA-11 PET scan and at least one lesion with PSMA expression less than or equal to uptake in normal liver, with the following size criteria in short axis: size criteria in short axis: organs >1 cm, lymph nodes >2.5 cm, bones (soft tissue component) >1 cm.
